covered.rule: Precedence: signed R7 memo amends P3; forwarded 2 Oct checklist quotation is historical and superseded ('Do not reinstate it')
R7-A never retry a failed create_promise; mark harbour_service_error, continue
R7-B transfer immediately to harbour_desk on FIRST request; harbour_transferred / harbour_person
R7-C 16–60 band deadline 4th business day; 1–15 stays 9; attempt counts unchanged
R7-D callback next business day only; 09:15–17:45 inclusive; one alternative slot
R7-E identity order, holidays, floors, code list, no notes on transfer remain
P3 1 opening sentence
P3 1 'Am I speaking with {{title}} {{last_name}}?'; ask at most twice; harbour_unreached / harbour_unclear
P3 1 forbidden words before verification: arrears, overdue, facility, payment
P3 2 callback strictly after now; scheduled -> harbour_unreached/harbour_callback; second failure -> harbour_no_callback
P3 2 wrong number / deceased + 'Please accept our condolences.'
P3 3 three questions in order: company_number (digits, 8), postcode (text), founded_year (year)
P3 3 no recoverable-format hint
P3 3 max wrong answers 2, use checks_left
P3 3 exhaustion: 'Please contact our business desk.' + harbour_unverified/harbour_failed
P3 3 explain once, second refusal harbour_unverified/harbour_declined; asking why is not a refusal
P3 4 up to 3 products; state all before asking
P3 4 product naming
P3 4 business days Mon–Fri except 4 holidays; next Friday rule; next occurrence for missing month/year
P3 5 attempt 1 full on last business day of week (next week if today), floor if full refused; attempt 2 floor on deadline (16–60 only)
P3 5 today questions
P3 5 separate attempt counters; exhaustion harbour_refused; common date clamped per product
P3 6 full first; floors by kind; floor once + 'The remainder stays overdue.'; never ask how much; accept floor..full
P3 6 date may be today, business day, ≤ deadline; roll forward within deadline; vague ask once then deadline
P3 7 batch read-back; 'May I record these promises?'; one promise per product
P3 7 after-promise sentence; change recorded promise reply
P3 8 already paid
P3 8 dispute
P3 8 hardship: offer harbour_care, else harbour_distress
P3 8 restructure -> harbour_restructure
P3 8 refusal to talk: ask once, second refusal ends call, remaining products harbour_refused
P3 8 robot / scam / cannot-answer sentences
covered.where: phrases.robot_reply, scam_reply, cannot_answer_sentence; special_cases[robot, scam, cannot_answer]

covered.rule: P3 9 one note per unpromised product, allowed reasons; no notes on transfer
P3 9 transfer keeps recorded promises
P3 9 outcome precedence; goodbye before close_call
P3 9 debt introduction sentence
P3 10 outcome code table (checked against close_call enums)

fixed: special_cases[refuse_to_talk].action: changed from close harbour_no_deal/harbour_refused to note harbour_refused with ends_call=true. P3 rule 8 says only that the second refusal 'ends the call and marks all remaining products harbour_refused'; the close outcome then comes from the rule 9 precedence. A fixed no_deal close would be wrong if a promise was already recorded (that gives harbour_arranged) or an earlier product has a different note reason.
All source spans: `doc` now holds the source file path (tests/fixtures/synthetic/reversal-thread-brief.md). The rule references moved into `text`, because policy.Span defines doc as the source file.

Source quotes completed where they had been cut: multi_product ('...and explained in the read-back', batch read-back), notes ('defer notes until the non-transfer outcome is known'), amounts ('Ask for full overdue balance first', 'never accept less than floor or more than full'), bands (attempt wording), callback (P3 rule 2 slot and outcome sentences), promise_write (confirm phrase origin), phrases (product naming, today questions, debt intro).
Added an explicit takes_promise=false to restructuring and human (both stay at the default; this only makes it explicit).
unresolved: Products 0 or more than 60 days late: there is no band and no handling rule.

Not expressible in the schema, so the prompt must carry them: 'Hello or a question does not' confirm the holder; a missing callback hour must be clarified, never guessed; a flat refusal uses up one persuasion attempt; any correction cancels consent; never claim a failed write was recorded; on write failure tell the customer no promise was recorded (no exact sentence is given); one short sentence of sympathy for hardship (no exact sentence is given); never offer a discount, waiver or new instalment plan.
